entry.title: What Should Students Check Before Starting a Statistics Assignment?
entry.content: Start by reading the assignment instructions carefully. Identify the main questions, required calculations, and expected format. Review your lecture notes and understand which statistical methods apply to each problem. It is also helpful to organise your data and show calculations step by step. If you get stuck, ask your tutor for clarification or buy statistics assignment seek guidance from a reliable academic resource. Make sure you understand the explanations rather than simply copying answer

entry.title: Bringing new life to Firefox's New Tab search box
entry.content: Hello! For years, text input into the New Tab search box has appeared in the address bar as you type. Internally we’ve been calling this interaction “the handoff” – and you’ll be pleased to hear it is going away. Making the New Tab search box actually work in place is one of our most requested features, so we’re delighted to be making that happen! Starting today you might spot a difference in the New Tab search box as we roll out this change. Some users will see one of a few experimental layouts
entry.dc:creator: Mozilla Connect

entry.title: Allow Canopy Shield to filter browsing content through Firefox built-in VPN on Windows
entry.content: For those who don't know, Canopy Shield is a parental control program that filters text and media content locally, unlike the traditional domain-based filtering that most other apps use. I discovered that the VPN bypasses this and I cannot block it separately without blocking the entire browser because the running process uses the same firefox.exe file name. This suggestion can expand to other parental control programs and operating systems and is in line with the existing approach at Trustworth
